analytics.title: Advanced analytics dashboard
analytics.categoryMasteryDesc: Your current accuracy in every category you have attempted. Categories with a single attempt are shown for completeness but may not be reliable.
analytics.categoryMasteryEmpty: Attempt some questions to see your category mastery.
analytics.streakHistoryDesc: Your day-by-day study activity over the selected window. Gaps indicate days without a finished session.
analytics.streakHistoryNoData: No study sessions in this window.
analytics.difficultyCalibrationDesc: Compares the difficulty label on each question with how test-takers actually performed. A well-calibrated bank shows three bars descending from easy to hard.
analytics.authorFlagRateDesc: Percentage of each author's published questions that have received at least one user report. Authors with zero flags are hidden.
analytics.examDurationDesc: How long users actually spend in a session, bucketed into five ranges. The average is shown above the histogram.
analytics.cohortComparisonDesc: Per-group aggregates over the recent window. Groups with no activity are hidden. Compare accuracy and volume side-by-side.
analytics.cohortComparisonEmpty: No groups with activity in this window.
analytics.weeklyRetentionDesc: Of the users who studied in one week, how many came back the next week. A rising line means the app is holding attention.
analytics.weeklyRetentionEmpty: Not enough weeks of history yet.
